about: The kit board capture of F7 (PLAN.md 3.4, 5.2 row 2): /playground in the board layout, 1300 x 5094 at scale 1 (the size of the Figma component board, node 80:2), tiled against _components-1..4.png by docs/pipeline/pulse/pkg/_int/kit-board-tiles.mjs. The layout is opened through the device's remembered choice (localStorage), not by a click: the list layout carries the legacy feedback matrix, whose JavaScript loops never let a page settle. The playground sits behind RequireAuth, so a signed-in account is needed; it reads nothing the account owns.

kit-board.title: Pulse kit — board layout
kit-board.why: the component board is a specimen sheet, not a screen: the host lays every lane's specimens out where the Figma board draws them
